privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Dune & Flame L.L.C., we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information.

section1.title: Information We Collect
section1.content:
We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us. This includes:

• Name and contact information (email, phone number, address)
• Payment information (processed securely through third-party providers)
• Order history and preferences
• Communications and feedback

We also automatically collect certain information about your device and browsing activity through cookies and similar tracking technologies.

section2.title: How We Use Your Information
section2.content:
We use the information we collect to:

• Process your orders and payments
• Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
• Send promotional emails and updates (with your consent)
• Improve our website and services
• Comply with legal obligations
• Prevent fraud and enhance security

section3.title: Data Security
section3.content: We implement advanced security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure. We encourage you to use strong passwords and keep your account information confidential.

section4.title: Third-Party Services
section4.content: We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers (payment processors, shipping partners, email providers) who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business. These partners are bound by strict confidentiality agreements.

section5.title: Your Privacy Rights
section5.content:
You have the right to:

• Access, update, or delete your personal information
• Opt-out of marketing communications
• Request data portability

To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@duneflame.com.

section6.title: Cookies
section6.content: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings, though some features may not work optimally if cookies are disabled.

section7.title: Contact Us
section7.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at info@duneflame.com or +971 52 145 0202.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: We are committed to delivering your premium Dune & Flame coffee quickly and safely to your doorstep.

uae.title: 🇦🇪 UAE (United Arab Emirates) Shipping
uae.freeShipping: FREE Shipping on orders over AED 200 (Standard only)
uae.serviceAreas: Service Areas: All Emirates (Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Ajman, Fujairah, Ras Al Khaimah, Sharjah, Umm Al Quwain)
uae.notes: Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be processed on the next business day.

gcc.title: 🌍 International GCC Shipping
gcc.regions: Available Countries: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman
gcc.standard: International Standard (7-10 business days): AED 75-120 (varies by country)
gcc.express: International Express (4-5 business days): AED 150-200 (varies by country)
gcc.processing: Processing Time: 2-3 business days before transit
gcc.customs: Customs & Duties: Customer is responsible for any customs duties or taxes imposed by the destination country.
gcc.restrictions: Some restricted items may not be available for international shipping. Please check specific coffee pages.

tracking.title: Order Tracking
tracking.content: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can use this to monitor your package's journey in real-time through our shipping partner's tracking system.

damaged.title: Damaged or Lost Shipments
damaged.content: If your package arrives damaged or is lost in transit, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the damage. We'll work with our shipping partner to investigate and provide a replacement or refund.

delays.title: Shipping Delays
delays.content: While we strive to meet our delivery timelines, delays may occur due to unforeseen circumstances (weather, customs, carrier delays). We'll keep you informed of any delays and work to resolve them quickly.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.intro: We want you to be completely satisfied with your Dune & Flame coffee. If you're not happy, we're here to help.

section1.title: 14-Day Return Policy
section1.content: Unopened coffee bags can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. The coffee must be in its original packaging and condition.

section2.title: Return Conditions
section2.items:
• Unopened coffee bags in original packaging
• Merchandise defects or damage (customer not responsible)
• Incorrect items sent
section2.exclude:
• Opened or partially used coffee bags
• Items damaged by customer misuse
• Custom orders or personalized items
• Clearance or sale items (unless defective)
section2.refundTime: Refund Timeline: Processing takes 7-10 business days after we receive your return. Refunds are credited to your original payment method.

section3.title: Cancellation Policy
section3.content:
Orders can be cancelled within 24 hours of placement. After 24 hours, orders enter processing and cannot be cancelled. Contact us immediately if you need to cancel:

Email: info@duneflame.com
Phone: +971 52 145 0202

section4.title: How to Return
section4.steps:
1. Contact us at info@duneflame.com with your order number
2. Provide reason for return and photos if applicable
3. We'll provide return shipping instructions and a label
4. Pack the item securely in its original packaging
5. Ship to our returns address using the provided label
6. Once received and inspected, we'll process your refund

section5.title: Defective Items
section5.content: If you receive a defective or damaged item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery. We'll arrange a replacement or full refund at no cost to you. No return shipment necessary for truly defective items—we'll cover all costs.

section6.title: Shipping Costs
section6.content: Complimentary return shipping is provided for defective items or incorrect orders. For customer-initiated returns of non-defective items, return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility.

section7.title: Questions?
section7.content:
For any questions about returns or refunds, please contact us:

Email: info@duneflame.com
Phone: +971 52 145 0202

about.title: OUR STORY
about.story: DuneFlame was born from a passion for exceptional coffee and a love of craftsmanship. In 2018, our founder traveled across the world's most renowned coffee-producing regions, connecting with farmers and roasters who shared our vision of quality.
about.missionText: To bring the world's finest single-origin coffees directly to your cup, celebrating the unique terroir and craftsmanship of each origin while supporting sustainable farming practices.
about.sustainabilityText: We're committed to environmental responsibility. All our packaging is compostable, and 5% of every purchase goes toward reforestation projects in coffee-producing regions. We work exclusively with farms that practice shade-growing and water conservation.
